result.evidence: In src/api/reports.ts, duplicating a report uses `truncate(`${source.name} (copy)`, MAX_NAME_LENGTH)`. When `source.name` is close to `MAX_NAME_LENGTH` (120 chars), appending ` (copy)` exceeds the limit and `truncate` replaces the end with `...`, resulting in a name ending in `...` instead of ` (copy)`. The validation schema `reportFields` also restricts report names to `z.string().min(1).max(MAX_NAME_LENGTH)`. To fix this properly, truncating the source name first (e.g. reserving space for ` (copy)`) or adjusting the name generation / validation logic is needed.
